name: Gamyoudou Suigen
source:
Sex: ?
Occupation: Sorcerer
Age: ? years old

A mysterious sorcerer. Although said to possess exceptional supernatural abilities, they have revealed nothing of their true identity. Both their age and gender are unknown.
* * *
[As of [I][url=/v42561]The Seven Mysteries of Honjo[/url][/I]]
Suigen Gamyodo was previously most known for their prominent media presence, with numerous appearances both on television and in magazines. Wearing an unusual outfit that covered their face, they would demonstrate a variety of psychic abilities, including exorcism of possessed individuals, assessment of submitted ghost photographs, identification of guiding spirits, and conduction of telepathic readings at haunted locations. Their unique sense of presence and high rate of accuracy garnered them a sizable following, particularly among occult enthusiasts, and they were known to accept consultations from the general public as well as media outlets.

[As of [I][url=/v62152]The Mermaid's Curse[/url][/I]]
[spoiler]However, [url=/v42561]the end of the previous year[/url] saw this once public figure suddenly withdraw from the spotlight. They now mainly operate behind closed doors, signing consulting agreements with particular companies to provide a variety of services, including management advice from a metaphysical perspective, divination of auspicious and harmful events, proposals to improve their clients' luck, and the detection and elimination of paranormal disturbances. It is rumored that they will even cast curses on key personnel at rival companies, or conversely exorcise curses from targeted victims, for the right price.
The undeniable potency of their spiritual abilities has earned them immense trust from both the executives of their contracted companies and other wealthy individuals, and their behind-the-scenes reputation continues to grow. This has resulted in a sharp rise in their consulting fees, placing their services far beyond what any average individual can reasonably hope to afford. One of the companies they currently have a contract with belongs to [url=/c164208]Shinobu Wakamura[/url], a local Kameshima magnate.
Among psychics, opinion on them is more divided. Many have noted that their spiritual ability during the time they were openly active in the media was too weak to allow them to perform advanced techniques of any sort —to the extent that they were considered little better than a fraud— leading to suspicions about what prompted their sudden change in course.
It is now almost impossible to find footage and articles from their past media appearances, and the names of the companies with which they have consulting contracts are entirely undisclosed, obfuscating their identity, purpose, and the true extent of their power.[/spoiler]

[From profile in [I]The Mermaid's Curse[/I]]

[spoiler]According to the results of an investigation conducted by the Paranormal Affairs Bureau, [url=https://vndb.org/c124623]the original Suigen Gamyodo[/url] retired following last year's incident involving the Seven Mysteries of Honjo, and a young man with exceptionally potent spirit sense has since taken her place.
Although this [url=/c124596]second Suigen Gamyodo[/url] has thus far focused on using his powerful abilities to solidify his social standing, his true purpose seems to be searching for a diviner by the name of Iyo Tokoro, who is said to be responsible for teaching the art of curses and other supernatural techniques to [url=/c124597]a certain ordinary woman[/url].
